[[Admiral]] '''Raddus''' was a [[Mon Calamari]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Mon Cala]]. He was an [[officer]] in the [[Mon Cala planetary defense services]], commanding those forces during the [[18 BBY]] [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[invasion of Mon Cala]] and eventually evacuating many [[MC-series star cruiser|city ships]] to evade the Empire. He became one of the first Mon Calamari to join the growing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], soon commanding its [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet]] as part of [[Alliance High Command|High Command]]. In [[1 BBY]], Raddus was [[Operation Fracture Oversight|involved]] in [[Operation Fracture]], an intelligence mission that intended to gather information about a suspected Imperial [[weapon]]. The operation revealed that the weapon was a planet-killing [[battle station]] called the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], and rebel [[Jyn Erso]] testified to the Alliance that her [[Parent|father]], Imperial [[scientist]] [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen Erso]], had built a weakness into the [[superweapon]] for the rebels to exploit.

Alliance High Command, much to Raddus's chagrin, deemed that a mission to retrieve the [[Death Star plans]] would be too dangerous to approve. Jyn, however, took a band of rebels calling themselves "[[Rogue One]]" and assaulted the [[Imperial Center of Military Research|security complex]] on the planet [[Scarif]] where the plans were kept anyway. When Raddus heard of this development, he prepped his [[flagship]], the ''[[Profundity]]'', to join her. This prompted the rest of the [[fleet]] to be approved for deployment, and when they arrived, Raddus ordered [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]] to reinforce Rogue One on the ground, with the rest of the [[starfighter]]s defending the fleet and engaging the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyers]].

Under Raddus's leadership, the Alliance's hodgepodge fleet was effective at battling the [[destroyer]]s and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]]. The admiral was able to disable [[Persecutor|one]] of the Star Destroyers, so when Rogue One [[pilot]] [[Bodhi Rook]] contacted the ''Profundity'' to explain that they needed Scarif's now-closed [[Shield Gate|shield gate]] to be broken open in order to transmit the plans, Raddus could shove the disabled [[Starship|ship]] into a [[Intimidator|second]], destroying them both along with the gate when they fell toward the planet. Erso successfully transmitted the plans to the ''Profundity'' but was [[Death|killed]] by the [[Death Star]] itself, and just as the fleet began to jump away to [[hyperspace]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] arrived in his Star Destroyer ''[[Devastator]]'', disabling Raddus's ship and killing him and everyone on board.

==Biography==
===Defending Mon Cala===
====Battle of Dac City====
{{Dialogue|Telvar|We are on the same side, after all.|Raddus|The giant battleship you parked in orbit around our planet suggests otherwise.|Lee-Char|Enough, Raddus.|attr=Mon Cala trade negotiations|src=<ref name="DV13" />}}
Raddus was a [[Mon Calamari]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="DB" /> [[Reproduction|born]] around [[66 BBY]]<ref name="Birth" /> in the [[waterworld]] of [[Mon Cala]]'s northern [[Temperature|colder]] polar regions. He served as the long-standing [[mayor]] of the [[city]] [[Nystullum]] in Mon Cala's north<ref name="X-wing 90" /> as part of its [[Nystullum city government|government]]<ref name="SWE" /> and as an [[admiral]] in<ref name="DV16">[[Darth Vader (2017) 16|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 16]]</ref> the [[Mon Calamari monarchy|monarchy's]]<ref name="DV13" /> [[Mon Cala planetary defense services]],<ref name="DV16" /> [[Advisor|advising]] [[King of Mon Cala]] [[Lee-Char]] and working with defense [[commander]] [[Gial Ackbar]].<ref name="X-wing 90" /> Two of his [[aide]]s in Nystullum were [[Shollan]] and [[Caitken]], who served with him on the defense staff.<ref name="Visual Guide" /> A senior member of the defense services, he was often present at court.<ref name="HC 79">{{HelmetCollectionCite|79|Weapons & Uniforms}}</ref> Raddus also developed a friendship with the Mon Calamari [[Dors Urtya]].<ref name="Battles">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref> At some point, he was awarded a [[Mon Cala civic crest|civic crest]] for planetary defense.<ref name="Insider219">{{InsiderCite|219|A Certain Point of View}}</ref>

[[File:DacPalaceInterior-2017DarthVader13.png|thumb|left|330px|Raddus (third from right) participating in Mon Cala's trade negotiations with the Empire]]
In [[18 BBY]],<ref name="DV13 date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Darth Vader (2017) 13|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 13]] to [[18 BBY]].</ref> the [[Galactic Empire]] sent [[Ambassador]] [[Telvar]] to Mon Cala to ostensibly negotiate a trade deal with Lee-Char. Telvar tried to make it seem like they were all on the same side, though Lee-Char was unconvinced that the deal would benefit anyone but the Empire. Raddus, who was in attendance at the meeting, retorted that the [[Sovereign|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[orbit]]ing the [[planet]] did not imply partnership. After Telvar had left, Lee-Char was concerned that the meeting had not gone well, with which Raddus agreed, harshly criticizing Telvar and the Empire and suggesting they secede right then. Lee-Char maintained that such a decision went beyond Mon Cala, referencing his [[Jedi]] advisor, [[Ferren Barr]]. As Raddus responded, an [[Infernum|Imperial shuttle]] flew in overhead.<ref name="DV13" />

Ackbar went to greet the [[Zeta-class shuttle|shuttle]], which carried [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] and several [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitors]]. As<ref name="DV13" /> he<ref name="DV15">[[Darth Vader (2017) 15|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 15]]</ref> questioned their authority to be there, Telvar's [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|shuttle]] exploded, leading the Empire to quickly give up their diplomatic efforts.<ref name="DV13" /> [[Imperial Army|Ground forces]] galore were deployed, and though the Mon Calamari fought back, the [[Dac City]] landing platform soon fell to [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]]. Raddus, Lee-Char, Ackbar, and other Mon Calamari and [[Quarren]] met to discuss how to repel the attacks, as all aboveground settlements were sustaining assaults. Lee-Char had ordered all residents to evacuate [[Water|underwater]], which Raddus saw as a surrender of sorts, but Lee-Char felt it was strategic to preserve as much life as possible.<ref name="DV14">[[Darth Vader (2017) 14|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 14]]</ref>

As the others left to command planetary defense, Lee-Char tried to reason with the Empire's [[Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]. The governor gave no room and advised the Mon Calamari to surrender at once. After the call, Lee-Char told Ackbar and Raddus via [[hologram]] to give up defending the surface and to enact his non-diplomacy plan. Just as Vader and the Inquisitors reached the [[king]] and began to interrogate him about a Jedi on Mon Cala, aquatic [[Unidentified Mon Cala creature|creatures]] sprung up from the [[ocean]]s, destroying the settlements and sending Imperial forces into the waters.<ref name="DV14" />

====Under attack, underwater====
{{Quote|Better than sitting here waiting to die. Some of us might make it through. We can return another day to liberate our home.|Raddus|<ref name="DV17">[[Darth Vader (2017) 17|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 17]]</ref>}}
Raddus headed resistance efforts in the south while keeping Mon Calamari [[reefship]]s in the polar regions. Tarkin warned [[Colonel]] [[Bergon]] not to underestimate Raddus's tactical skills.<ref name="DV15" /> Indeed, Raddus repurposed the [[Mon Cala Mercantile Fleet]] to be a fortress in which his forces could be protected, thanks to the [[fleet]]'s powerful [[deflector shield]]s. The shields held strong, which Raddus had expected, and he admitted to a [[Unidentified Mon Calamari commander (Mon Cala)|commander]] that he hoped, to a certain extent, that the Imperials did not give up their attack and kept engaging with the Mon Calamari.<ref name="DV16" />

[[File:MonCalaFleet-2017DarthVader16.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Raddus elected to launch the Mon Cala fleet instead of sitting back during the Empire's bombardment.]]
However, the [[Star Destroyer]]s above began an [[orbital bombardment]] of Mon Cala, quickly destroying five cities in the north. Raddus surmised that the planet's curve would buy them some [[time]] as they were in the south, but he knew that once the Empire reached them, their shields would eventually give. He instructed his forces to continue fighting until he signaled for the [[cruiser]]s to scatter. Meanwhile, Lee-Char had come to the conclusion that since Barr had initiated the violence by assassinating Telvar, if he ordered a ceasefire, the Imperials would respect it. Raddus was shocked when he heard the command to stand down, but Tarkin continued the bombardment without mercy.<ref name="DV16" />

Raddus decided to take matters into his own hands, ordering all cruisers to launch even with the understanding that some would not make it past the Imperial [[Occupation of Mon Cala|blockade]]. He hoped that a people of the sea could perhaps also fare in [[Realspace|space]].<ref name="DV17" /> Raddus, one of the first to join<ref name="Secret Mission">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: Secret Mission]]''</ref> the nascent<ref name="Battles" /> [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="Secret Mission" /> quickly<ref name="X-wing 90" /> led the city ships, or [[MC-series star cruiser]]s, to join them. The Alliance's leader, [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]], noted in a file titled "[[Short Notes on the History of the Rebel Alliance Navy]]" that their arrival had been a "shocking boon" and perhaps undeserved as the rebels had been relatively unsuccessful in resisting the occupation of Mon Cala,<ref name="Novel">[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]]</ref> though the planet's resistance had strengthened the rebels.<ref name="Secret Mission" /> Ackbar also joined the young Alliance around the same time as Raddus. Their friend Urtya, however, had elected to collaborate with the Empire and stayed behind on Mon Cala, hoping to shield their people from Imperial vengeance.<ref name="Battles" />

===Fish of the fleet===
{{Quote|My aides Caitken and Shollan have assembled this on my behalf. Know this: we are scraping by on smaller vessels until we get the heavy hitters online. The Alliance is not yet ready for a fleet engagement against the Empire.|Raddus, in a report to Mon Mothma|<ref name="TRF">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref>}}
Becoming an [[officer]] for the Alliance, Raddus advocated for smaller hit-and-run attacks on the Empire and then disappearing, moving from base to base to detract attention.<ref name="Secret Mission" /> Mothma considered Raddus to be the Alliance's most important military officer.<ref name="Altaya Rebel Alliance">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Rebel Alliance}}</ref> Nonetheless, his aggressive strategy clashed with the more methodical style pioneered by Ackbar.<ref name="TLJ VD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Sometime between [[5 BBY]] and [[4 BBY]],<ref name="TRF date1">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''{{'}} report about [[Faa-Char]] and Raddus was delivered between the [[mission to free Wookiee prisoners]] and the [[action at Mustafar]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' respectively dates to [[5 BBY]] and [[4 BBY]].</ref> rebel [[general]] [[Davits Draven]] sent a report to Mothma concerning other rebel factions<ref name="TRF" />—he<ref name="Visual Guide" /> noted that while Raddus and his bloc had joined the larger Alliance, other Mon Cals, commanded by [[Faa-Char]], were still acting on their own. Draven argued that Raddus's actions had branded all Mon Calamari as traitors in the eyes of the Empire.<ref name="TRF" />

[[File:RebelCouncilDocument-RF.png|thumb|left|250px|Raddus was among the rebel leaders on the Rebel Council's first iteration.]]
Between 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and [[3 BBY]],<ref name="Date 3BBY">In ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'', the report from [[Caitken]] and [[Shollan]] is set between the [[blockade of Ibaar]] and the [[Mission to Ryloth (Phoenix Squadron)|mission to Ryloth]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' respectively dates to [[4 BBY]] and [[3 BBY]].</ref> Raddus sent an assessment compiled by Shollan and Caitken of the fledgling [[Rebel Alliance Navy]], which at that point was primarily comprised of [[Braha'tok-class gunship|''Braha'tok''-class gunships]], [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvettes]], [[CR-series|Alderaanian cruisers]], [[Pelta-class frigate|''Pelta''-class frigates]], and [[GR-75 medium transport]]s. Raddus gauged that without larger, heavy-hitting [[Starship|vessels]], the fleet was not ready for a major engagement with the Empire.<ref name="TRF" /> He made regular reports on the fleet's status<ref name="Altaya Rebel Alliance" /> and, with the help of [[General]] [[Antoc Merrick]], transformed the fleet into a legitimate fighting force, something that Mothma found welcome yet startling. Part of Raddus' efforts involved ensuring [[Rebel pilot]]s could fly together as trusted comrades.<ref name="Novel" />

By [[2 BBY]],<ref name="2BBY">According to ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'', Raddus was the [[Supreme fleet commander|fleet commander]] when [[Mon Mothma]] resigned from the [[Imperial Senate]], an event that ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[2 BBY]].</ref> Raddus was the [[Supreme fleet commander|fleet commander]] of the [[navy]], with Colonel [[Anj Zavor]] as his liaison.<ref name="TRF" /> The ''[[Profundity]]'', the former civic governance tower of Nystullum, acted as his [[flagship]], one of the first such vessels converted for [[Galactic Civil War|war]]. In his role as fleet commander, Raddus was not often present in the [[Great Temple|rebel bases]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]<ref name="Visual Guide" /> or the planet<ref name="Dantooine">{{Databank|dantooine|Dantooine}}</ref> [[Dantooine]]<ref name="X-wing 90" /> as he was mainly stationed in the [[Telaris system]],<ref name="Geek">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> though he did sometimes come when [[Alliance High Command]] required him there<ref name="Visual Guide" /> and also joined via hologram.<ref name="SWE" /> At some point, he questioned a rebel-aligned individual of their loyalties.<ref name="Outer Rim">[[Star Wars: Outer Rim|''Star Wars'': Outer Rim]]</ref> He was part of High Command when Mothma resigned from the [[Imperial Senate]] and officially [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance|brought]] the various rebel factions together—she acknowledged in a journal entry that views like Raddus's, which necessarily involved fighting, clashed with those such as Senator [[Tynnra Pamlo]], who advocated for working within the Imperial system to find peace.<ref name="TRF" /> By [[1 BBY]],<ref name="1 BBY">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of the [[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]] to [[1 BBY]].</ref> Raddus had dozens of grandchildren.<ref name="Novel" />

===Planet killer===
====Interesting intelligence====
{{Quote|What kind of a weapon are we talking about?|Raddus, to Cassian Andor|<ref name="JKE">{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}}</ref>}}
[[File:RaddusDraven-JedhaKyberErso.png|thumb|right|300px|Raddus and Davits Draven discuss the return of Andor's unauthorized U-wing to Yavin 4.]]
That year,<ref name="JKE date">{{AndorDate|212}}</ref> after [[Captain]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] embarked on an unauthorized [[Raid on the Axis safehouse|rescue mission]] on<ref name="JKE" /> the planet<ref name="SWE" /> [[Coruscant]], Raddus was present with members of<ref name="JKE" /> [[Signal Intelligence (Rebel Alliance)|Signal Intelligence]]<ref name="Visual Guide" /> monitoring the situation, sending for Draven. [[Rebel technician|Technician]] [[Tenzigo Weems]] reported that Andor's [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft|ship]] was transmitting, requesting a landing despite being unauthorized—Raddus reminded Weems of the protocol: to scramble three ships and put two on deck as backup. As Draven arrived, Raddus remarked that if General Merrick were present, he would personally shoot down the ship. Soon after, Andor's ship landed and was secured.<ref name="JKE" />

The Rebel Council gathered to hear Andor speak. Raddus pointed out they did not have a quorum, though Senator Pamlo noted they were not planning to vote. Andor explained that he had indeed gone to rescue secret rebel leader [[Luthen Rael]], as Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] had asked him, but he only managed to rescue Rael's assistant, [[Kleya Marki]], as Rael was dead. Andor relayed that Marki brought urgent information from Rael about the true nature of the Empire's energy project, which was, in fact, a cover story for the manufacture of a [[Project Stardust|secret weapon]]. Raddus pressed to know the nature of the weapon, but Andor had shared all the details he had.<ref name="JKE" />

[[File:CouncilMeeting-JedhaKyberErso.png|thumb|left|300px|Raddus attends a council meeting for Andor's debriefing.]]
Senators Pamlo and [[Nower Jebel]], as well as Organa, were quick to doubt the accuracy of Rael's information despite Andor's insistence that it was trustworthy. Mothma was wary to do nothing based on the information; Raddus replied that Generals [[Jan Dodonna]] and Merrick would return the following night, allowing a full discussion on the matter. Andor was livid at the delay, urging them to consider it active intelligence, but Organa asserted that the council would have a full session the following day once the others returned. With that, he forbid Andor from accessing his ship and confined him to his quarters.<ref name="JKE" />

====Critical council====
{{Quote|If she's telling the truth, we need to act now!|Raddus|audio=Raddus-ActNow-RO.flac|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
Soon after the briefing, the Alliance began to act on the intelligence. Raddus became part of the Rebel Council that made up the [[Operation Fracture Oversight|oversight committee]] for [[Operation Fracture]],<ref name="Novel" /> which hoped to extract Erso so he could testify to the Senate regarding the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|secret weapon]]. As the operation progressed, Raddus communicated to Mothma that a U-wing extraction was probable and that [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]], [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]], and [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] were ready to be deployed, as was a slightly depleted [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]]. He felt that the navy could provide whatever support Fracture and Andor, who was leading the forces, required. The report was included in [[Operation Fracture dossier|dossier]] of information provided by [[General]] [[Airen Cracken]] to Mothma concerning Operation Fracture.<ref name="Dossier">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: Rebel Dossier]]''</ref>

[[File:RaddusMeeting-RO.png|thumb|right|370px|Raddus argued vehemently against giving in to the Empire.]]
Sometime later, Mothma received intelligence that the [[Superweapon|weapon]], which they suspected to be a "planet [[Death|killer]]," was at the moon Jedha—this concerned Raddus, who offered to move a long-range cargo [[freighter]] to the mission if needed.<ref name="Novel" /> Indeed, Andor shortly after sent a message to the Yavin base informing them that the [[Jedha City|Holy City]] on Jedha had been [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] and updated them on Erso's location. Blue Squadron ended up joining Andor's mission, [[Mission to Eadu|meeting]] up with him at the planet [[Eadu]] and [[assassin]]ating Erso. Andor soon returned to Yavin, bringing with him [[Jyn Erso]], the [[Erso family|daughter]] of Galen, who testified to the Rebellion about her rebel history and her [[Parent|father]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

During the debriefing, Raddus asked her about her involvement with the extremist rebel [[Saw Gerrera]], which she was able to answer to the admiral's satisfaction.<ref name="Novel" /> When the discussion reached the [[weapon]], whose power was now known thanks to Jedha and whose name was revealed to be "the [[Death Star]]," some Alliance leaders voiced that surrender was the only option in the face of such a threat. Raddus, on the other hand, proclaimed the need for swift action if Jyn, who claimed that her father built a fatal weakness into the weapon, was telling the truth<ref name="Rogue One" />—that "if" was hard for her to hear as she had thought he supported her.<ref name="Novel" /> Jyn then gave a speech proposing that the Rebellion stage a raid on the planet [[Scarif]], where the [[Death Star plans]] were held. While Raddus and some others supported her drive to fight, most of Alliance High Command was against the idea.<ref name="Rogue One" /> Instead of fighting, the ''Profundity'' was set to escort the under-maintenance cruiser ''[[Tantive IV]]'' to the planet [[Tatooine]] so that [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] could recruit [[Exile (punishment)|exiled]] [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="Geek" />

====Raddus the Rogue Rebel====
{{Quote|Red and Gold Squadrons, attack formations. Defend the fleet. Blue Squadron, get to the surface before they close that gate.|Raddus|audio=Raddus-Squadrons-RO.flac|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
Soon after, a [[Rebel trooper|rebel soldier]] frantically informed Raddus that Jyn Erso and many others had commandeered a stolen [[SW-0608|''Zeta''-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle]]. Raddus surmised that they were heading to Scarif to [[Battle of Scarif|steal]] the Death Star plans and ordered that the ''Profundity'' be prepared for departure, inspired by the belief in the Rebellion that the group, calling themselves "[[Rogue One]]," maintained.<ref name="RO5">[[Rogue One Adaptation 5|''Rogue One Adaptation'' 5]]</ref> Once Mothma heard of Raddus's decision, she knew there was no stopping him after all that Mon Cala had been through.<ref name="HC 79 Highlights">{{HelmetCollectionCite|79|Highlights of the Saga}}</ref> The fleet was quickly scrambled, with Raddus having already contacted all [[capital ship]]s close enough to Yavin and Scarif.<ref name="Novel" /> He communicated to Mothma a summary of the various forces he expected to have once they made it to Scarif.<ref name="TRF" /> Just before they made the jump to [[hyperspace]], reports came in of explosions on Scarif.<ref name="RO5" />

[[File:MonCalamariTrio-RO.png|thumb|left|350px|Raddus commanding his forces at Scarif]]
Raddus and [[Blue Leader]] General Merrick discussed strategy before they reached Scarif.<ref name="JN">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel]]''</ref> Rogue One's ground assault was well underway by the time the fleet arrived in the [[Scarif system]]. As [[Squad leader|squadron leaders]] reported in,<ref name="Rogue One" /> Raddus considered their enemy's defensive firepower and reflected on, among other reasons to fight, how little of a chance Mon Cala would have if the Death Star survived.<ref name="Novel" /> He ordered Red and Gold squadrons to assume attack formation<ref name="Rogue One" /> and engage the two Star Destroyers<ref name="Novel" /> and for Blue Squadron to reinforce Rogue One on the ground before the [[Shield Gate|shield gate]] closed.<ref name="Rogue One" />

====Strategy at Scarif====
{{Quote|What's going on down there, Lieutenant?''"<br />"''Unknown, sir. We can't raise them. All rebel frequencies are blocked.''"<br />"''Keep trying. Engage those Star Destroyers and let's start probing that shield!''"<br />"''Yes, sir!|Raddus and Shollan|audio=Raddus-Shollan-RO.flac|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
Along with assignments for the starfighter [[squadron]]s, Raddus's strategy was for two thirds of the fleet to each support Red and Gold Squadrons and for the remaining third to defend the flank to preserve an escape route. The ''Profundity'' was to cover Blue Squadron and target the shield gate. The admiral felt that the plan, which he cobbled together based on engagements at the locations [[Nexator system|Nexator]] and [[Carsanza system|Carsanza]], was a bit simple but the best that could be done with the time constraints. He watched his [[holodisplay]]s and [[viewport]] to see Hammerhead corvettes sustain Imperial fire and Blue Squadron losing a fighter as they rushed to help Rogue One.<ref name="Novel" />

[[File:LetsStartProbingThatShield.png|thumb|right|350px|Raddus relays orders to Lieutenant Shollan.]]
As the battle progressed, the Empire blocked all rebel frequencies, preventing the rebels from knowing what was happening on Scarif itself,<ref name="Rogue One" /> at which Raddus swore when he learned of it. He ordered his [[starfighter]]s to hit the Star Destroyers and the shield gate hard, the latter of which had closed, in an attempt to buy Erso and her team time. Raddus was able to limit the Star Destroyers' effectiveness by hitting them from all sides, forcing them to spread their firepower.<ref name="Novel" />

Dozens of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] joined the fighting, rocking the ''Profundity'' and damaging its shields down to fifty percent. Raddus had no intention of turning back, urging that the fleet press the attack.<ref name="Rogue One" /> In response, he pulled the ''Profundity'' back in order to stretch the Empire's [[TIE series|fighters]]. His forces, however, were making but a dent in the shield gate as their losses abounded.<ref name="Novel" /> He had gone in merely hoping to buy Rogue One time, but now that Rogue One was trapped below, he needed a victory rather than a draw.<ref name="Battles" /> Looking for an opportunity to shift the battle's tide, Raddus noticed that he could move ships to distract the Star Destroyer ''[[Persecutor]]''. This opened a lane for Gold Squadron to fully immobilize the [[destroyer]], after which Raddus redirected his forces to continue berating the other destroyer, the ''[[Intimidator]]'', along with the shield gate.<ref name="Novel" />

====Plans and plight====
{{Quote|Rogue One, may the Force be with you. All ships, prepare for jump to hyperspace.|Raddus|audio=Raddus-ForceBeWithYou-RO.flac|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
When Rogue One [[pilot]] [[Bodhi Rook]] called from below that destroying the shield gate was vital to transmitting the plans, Raddus had an idea: he called up the Hammerhead [[corvette]] ''[[Lightmaker]]'' to shove the ''Persecutor'' into the ''Intimidator'',<ref name="Rogue One" /> at which the ''Lightmaker''{{'s}} captain, [[Kado Oquoné]], was angered at first but then accepted as the necessary move. With a skeleton crew after evacuating nonessential personnel,<ref name="Novel" /> the corvette wrecked them both, breaking open the gate as they fell<ref name="Rogue One" /> and turning the momentum in the battle toward the rebels.<ref name="Battles" /> Raddus quickly moved the ''Profundity'' close to the shield opening and brought forces to defend it, knowing that they would not have long before the shield regenerated. He took a brief moment to decide that he would name his great-grandchildren after Oquoné and his crew.<ref name="Novel" />

[[File:RaddusEyesClosed-RO.png|thumb|left|350px|Raddus takes a moment of silence for Rogue One's sacrifice.]]
Soon after, the ''Profundity'' began receiving a transmission from Scarif,<ref name="Rogue One" /> and after confirming the data at Raddus's request,<ref name="Novel" /> Shollan announced that they had secured the plans. The Death Star itself then emerged from hyperspace and targeted the base at Scarif. Raddus [[May the Force be with you|wished]] for [[the Force]] to be with Rogue One,<ref name="Rogue One" /> knowing they would not survive,<ref name="Birth 2">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Birth of the Rebellion}} {{C|English edition}}</ref> and took a brief moment of silence before commanding all rebel ships to jump to hyperspace. Many successfully did so—however, the ''Profundity'' was incapacitated by the Star Destroyer ''[[Devastator]]'',<ref name="Rogue One" /> which Raddus had recognized as Darth Vader's. He requested a damage report but knew that they had no chance of escape,<ref name="JN" /> so he ordered the ''Tantive IV'', which had been undergoing repairs while docked with the ''Profundity'', to take the plans and escape,<ref name="Novel" /> giving the rebels a chance even if he would not live to see it through.<ref name="JN" /> The ''Profundity'' was destroyed,<ref name="Timelines" /> with Raddus and all his subordinates aboard perishing.<ref name="Altaya Rebel Alliance" />

===Legacy===
====Legendary rebel====
{{Quote|Ackbar lives, but Raddus is… gone. He died to ensure the destruction of a great Imperial war machine. It's a long story…''"<br />"''A great one, Raddus. We had such hopes.|Organa and Lee-Char|<ref name="SW48">[[Star Wars (2015) 48|''Star Wars'' (2015) 48]]</ref>}}
[[File:LeeCharCritical-2015StarWars47.png|thumb|right|250px|In his final [[Standard day|days]], Lee-Char was saddened to hear of Raddus's death.]]
The Alliance was ultimately able to use the stolen plans to destroy the Death Star in the [[Battle of Yavin]], before which General Dodonna led analysis of the plans in Raddus's place. Admiral Gial Ackbar took over as the commander of the Alliance fleet, and Raddus came to be a rebel legend for his sacrifice,<ref name="Battles" /> inspiring others to join the Rebellion.<ref name="BC14">{{BustCollectionCite|36|Star Wars Universe}}</ref> In [[1 ABY]],<ref name="Mutiny date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Book X: Mutiny at Mon Cala]]'' to [[1 ABY]].</ref> Ackbar and Organa mentioned Raddus when trying to convince<ref name="SW44">[[Star Wars (2015) 44|''Star Wars'' (2015) 44]]</ref> Raddus's friend<ref name="Battles" /> Dors Urtya, by that time a [[Grand Admiral]] of the Mon Cala Mercantile Fleet, to help the Rebellion. Urtya reminded them that Raddus had died for the cause and that King Lee-Char remained in Imperial captivity, unwilling to ask all of Mon Cala to make the same sacrifice.<ref name="SW44" /> Ackbar later opined to Organa that Raddus would have been quite excited at the capabilities against the Empire held by the fleet they were building up.<ref name="SW45">[[Star Wars (2015) 45|''Star Wars'' (2015) 45]]</ref>

The rebels decided to stage a [[prison]] breakout to free Lee-Char and inspire the Mon Calamari. Upon reaching him, they discovered that he was poorly and kept alive by machinery only. He was able to speak, asking if Raddus was among the rebels' number—Organa confirmed that he had been but had died a hero, and Lee-Char acknowledged the admiral's greatness.<ref name="SW48" />

====Cruiser namesake and historical figure====
{{Quote|Although the rebel fleet under Admiral Raddus had the benefit of surprise, and Raddus was a far better military commander than his adversary Admiral Gorin, an examination of the opposing forces suggests that the two Imperial Star Destroyers guarding the planet—the ''Intimidator'' and the ''Persecutor''—should not have been fought to a standstill and then subsequently destroyed along with the shield gate.|Beaumont Kin, ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''|<ref name="Rise">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref>}}
By [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Rebel Files date">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' establishes that ''[[The Rebel Files]]'' was buried during [[Hendri Underholt]]'s [[Bombardment of Durkteel|mission]] to [[Durkteel]] on the same [[Standard day|day]] as the [[Battle of Endor]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[4 ABY]]. As the former also states that ''The Rebel Files'' was [[Excavation on Durkteel|rediscovered]] thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the battle, the artifact must have been found in [[34 ABY]].</ref> Draven's report on rebel factions, Raddus's reports on the fleet and on Scarif forces, and Mothma's notes on rebel leaders were among the documents compiled in ''[[The Rebel Files]]'', a collection of non-electronic records, by rebel [[Hendri Underholt]]. [[34 ABY|Thirty years later]], members of the [[Resistance]] movement against the [[First Order]], which included rebel veterans, annotated the files when they were rediscovered. Admiral Ackbar concurred with his predecessor's assessment that the rebel fleet had not been ready for a major engagement and expressed surprise at the size of Raddus's forces at Scarif, particularly as he only had one heavy [[battleship]]. Ackbar also noted that when he took over as fleet commander, the navy was severely underequipped, and he had been unprepared to take Raddus's position.<ref name="TRF" />

[[File:MC85-Star-Cruiser-Front.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Raddus'' was named after the legendary Mon Calamari admiral.]]
In building its [[Resistance navy|fleet]], the Resistance acquired an [[MC85 Star Cruiser]] from the [[New Republic]]. Ackbar personally petitioned to have it be renamed the [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']] from ''Dawn of Tranquility'' in honor of the fallen admiral, hoping that they, too, could rise up against insurmountable odds.<ref name="TLJ cross">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> Ackbar had come to better respect his colleague in the years since his falling in battle.<ref name="TLJ VD" />

Raddus was also mentioned in an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal's]] section on Mon Calamari, which was restored, expanded, and displayed at the [[Graf Archive]]<ref name="AA">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> at some point no earlier than 34 ABY.<ref name="Year">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref>

[[Historian]] [[Beaumont Kin]] later wrote about the Battle of Scarif in<ref name="Rise" /> his<ref name="SWE" /> [[35 ABY]]<ref name="35 ABY">{{RiseAndFallDate}}</ref> [[book]] ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''. He argued that Raddus had been a far superior commander to the Empire's, Admiral [[Gorin]], but that the Imperial forces still should have been able to better defend themselves from the surprise rebel attack. Drawing from both [[Rebel Alliance Archives|Rebel Alliance]] and [[Imperial Archives]], he noted that the rebels' success had sparked [[Standard week|weeks]] of discussion within the Empire.<ref name="Rise" /> A [[Unidentified historical book|book]] describing objects relating to [[Timeline of galactic history|galactic history]] included an entry on the [[MDS-440 datapad]], which mentioned the ''Raddus'' and the legacy of its fallen namesake.<ref name="100 Objects">''[[Star Wars 100 Objects]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We can't just give in!|Raddus|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
A pragmatic<ref name="Visual Guide" /> and careful tactician, Raddus believed in incorporating odds and numbers into strategy, removing emotion from the equation.<ref name="Secret Mission" /> He developed his outlook from his home oceans, whose polar cold temperatures were said to make natives' [[blood]] run thicker—Raddus enjoyed this reputation, having no interest in social pleasantries when interacting, instead acting stern, gruff, and dour in the interest of practicality.<ref name="Visual Guide" /> He found it challenging to adjust to having non–Mon Calamari be part of the ''Profundity''{{'s}} staff.<ref name="Novel" /> Raddus avoided concerning himself with [[politics]]<ref name="Dawn">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> and had no patience for diplomacy<ref name="Front Lines">''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]''</ref>—Rebel Council meetings, full of deliberation instead of action, frustrated him,<ref name="X-wing 90" /> though he tried to remain amicable during them.<ref name="Altaya Rebel Alliance" />

[[File:Admiral_Raddus_SWA_Romana_Kendelic.png|thumb|right|280px|Admiral Raddus had to make weighty decisions at Scarif.]]
Raddus knew the importance of trusting those one would fly alongside, arguing the point with a personal saying of "No one wants to fly in formation with a stranger." Scarif was a difficult battle for Raddus to lead. Inspired by the thought of standing up to tyranny as siblings together and of saving Mon Cala, he was forced to make tough choices, including sending the ''Lightmaker'' on a one-way trip to break open the shield. As Mon Calamari had far more offspring than [[human]]s, many of whom did not live to come of age, Raddus was not as devastated at the deaths of individuals, though he anticipated that the deaths of hundreds would come to haunt him. Nonetheless, he remained calm throughout the battle and was of the opinion that a great commander should feel each loss emotionally but not let it cloud their judgment.<ref name="Novel" />

While watching the Death Star [[Superlaser|laser]] destroy Rogue One, Raddus was able to keep his composure but was still quite emotional. Sacrificing everything so that the Rebel Alliance might fight on was the ultimate source of pride for Raddus, having been able to contribute his particular tactical skillset to the cause.<ref name="Geek" /> Raddus had [[Color|gray]] skin with a dark complexion, yellow [[eye]]s, and stood 1.9 [[meter]]s tall (6 [[Foot|feet]], 3 inches). His chromatophoric skin helped him camouflage.<ref name="Visual Guide" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|I want one-third of the fleet each supporting Red and Gold Squadrons. That should force those Destroyers to engage. The remainder will protect our flank; when the Empire brings in reinforcements, I don't want our escape route cut off.|Raddus explains his strategy at Scarif|<ref name="Novel" />}}
Raddus's tactical prowess allowed him to redirect Imperial forces during their invasion of Mon Cala to where he needed them. He was talented at managing both ground and space engagements.<ref name="X-wing 90" /> As an experienced and strategic leader, Raddus was effective at commanding the rebel fleet<ref name="CharEncyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> and forged it into an actual military force. According to Mon Mothma, the work Raddus and General Merrick performed in hammering together the Alliance fleet ensured it was not something like a pirate armada.<ref name="Novel" /> Historical analysis found that he had far out-commanded Gorin at the Battle of Scarif.<ref name="Rise" /> He had earned the monikers "Raddus of Mon Cala," "Raddus of the Floes," and "Raddus of the Clutch of Zadasurr and the Spear of Tryphar" across his career.<ref name="Novel" /> Highly intelligent and strong, he was not [[Force-sensitive]].<ref name="GFiles">{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files|cardname=Admiral Raddus|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/170092/cid/11644221/2018-Topps-Star-Wars:-Galactic-Files-RO-28-Admiral-Raddus}}</ref>

==Equipment==
{{Quote|We must return to the ''Profundity'' and prepare for departure.|Raddus|<ref name="RO5" />}}
Raddus carried a [[DH-17 blaster pistol]]<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Rogue One (toy line)|pack=Admiral Raddus|altlink=http://www.rebelscum.com/Admiral-Raddus-C1973-B7072-Rogue-One-Hasbro.asp}}</ref> along with a coded<ref name="CVDNE">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> waterproof [[datapad]] that contained his orders.<ref name="CharEncyclopedia" /> He wore a blue [[Alliance military uniform|rebel naval uniform]]<ref name="Sticker">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: Ultimate Sticker Encyclopedia]]''</ref> with his civic crest affixed to a [[Clothing|vest]]. He also had black shoes.<ref name="CharEncyclopedia" /> The ''Profundity'' served as his flagship after Raddus escaped the occupation of Mon Cala with it—it was one of the first city ships to be refitted as a war-able capital ship.<ref name="X-wing 90" />

[[File:RaddusBTS.jpg|thumb|right|330px|Gareth Edwards on set with Admiral Raddus]]
Director [[Gareth Edwards]] described Raddus as portly with a strong personality, so creature designer [[Neal Scanlan]] and his team landed on [[Wikipedia:Winston Churchill|Winston Churchill]],<ref name="Moviemaking" /> the British Prime Minister during World War II.<ref name="EW">{{WebCite|url=https://ew.com/article/2016/11/18/rogue-one-admiral-raddus-character-inspired-winston-churchill|text=Rogue One: Meet Admiral Raddus, the character inspired by Winston Churchill|author=Anthony Breznican|date=2016-11-18|archivedate=20200616053333}}</ref> [[Martin Rezard]] and [[Adam Brockbank]] produced concept art of Raddus,<ref name="Art of">''[[The Art of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> using wartime photos of Churchill as a reference to create Raddus's jowly face. The team decided to introduce Mon Calamari with entirely different skin tones than Ackbar and others had had in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film {{Film|VI}} to show that Mon Calamari, like humans, came in different races. Raddus, unlike Caitken and Shollan, was also set apart from Ackbar in terms of his shape, with stronger features and bone structure. Scanlan described him as "more like a pike than he is a perch," while Ackbar had been "goldfishy."<ref name="Moviemaking" /> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Pablo Hidalgo]] noted that having the grayscale Mon Cals be from colder, polar regions while having colorful skin tones be from tropical parts of Mon Cala worked with Raddus's no-nonsense attitude.<ref name="RO Aliens Pablo">{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-talking-rogue-one-aliens-with-pablo-hidalgo|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: Talking ''Rogue One'' Aliens with Pablo Hidalgo}}</ref>

Raddus was played in costume by [[Paul Kasey]], who wore a suit and animatronic mask,<ref name="Moviemaking" /> the latter of which was supervised by [[Gustav Hoegen]].<ref name="Art of" /> Kasey studied Churchill's wartime speeches to get a feel for how to portray Raddus's body language.<ref name="Moviemaking" /> He described working on ''Rogue One'' as a "complete joy," and while he could not see or hear anything while in the costume, he could communicate with puppeteer [[Patrick Comerford]], who controlled Raddus's head during production. Comerford was able to relay direction to Kasey, who also mentioned that he enjoyed being able to get into character during shooting.<ref name="Kasey interview">{{YouTube|video=wHYs4iHZBeI|text=Star Wars Paul Kasey Interview Rogue One Admiral Raddus|channel=@RedCarpetNewsTV|name=Red Carpet News TV}}</ref> For Raddus' return in the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', the costume was completely rebuilt by the Creature department.<ref name="Andor Trivia">{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-4|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 4 Trivia}}</ref> He was then played by [[James Henri-Thomas]].<ref name="JKE" />

===A veteran voice===
{{Quote|So it wasn't until I got to Disney's ADR stage and met with [supervising sound editor] Matthew Wood, who recorded me, that I found out the real name of the character, Admiral Raddus. And then he said, 'Oh, it's this Mon Calamari,' and he showed me a picture and I thought, 'That's the character I saw in the sizzle reel!' Because the sizzle reel had come out, and you had seen glimpses of things, but you didn't know who was who or what was what.|Stephen Stanton|<ref name="Tarkin to Raddus">{{SW|url=news/from-tarkin-to-raddus-star-wars-voice-actor-stephen-stanton-looks-back|text=From Tarkin to Raddus: ''Star Wars'' Voice Actor Stephen Stanton Looks Back}}</ref>}}
[[File:StephenStantonRaddus.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Stephen Stanton in the recording studio for ''Rogue One'' production]]
Veteran ''[[Star Wars]]'' voice actor [[Stephen Stanton]] provided Raddus's voice, combining Churchill with actor [[Wikipedia:George C. Scott|George C. Scott's]] interpretation of<ref name="Tarkin to Raddus" /> U.S. Army general [[Wikipedia:George S. Patton|George S. Patton]], who also served in World War II, from the 1970 film [[Wikipedia:Patton (film)|''Patton'']].<ref name="Patton">[[Wikipedia:Patton (film)|''Patton'']]</ref> Stanton had no idea the voice was for ''Star Wars'' when he turned in his audition, only finding out when his agent informed him he got the job. Sound editor [[Matthew Wood]] showed Stanton a picture of Raddus when he went in for the first of two recording sessions, and he recognized his character from a sizzle reel that [[Lucasfilm]] had released for ''Rogue One''.<ref name="Tarkin to Raddus" /> The character has become one of Stanton's favorites in the ''Star Wars'' universe.<ref name="StantonTweet">{{Twitter|username=Stephen_Stanton|url=status/1922756817475580234|name=[[Stephen Stanton]]|date=2025-05-14|quote=A big thanks to Tony Gilroy & Dan Gilroy for bringing Admiral Raddus back for #Andor Season 2! It was wonderful to give voice once again to one of my favorite #StarWars characters almost 10 years after #RogueOne! #MayTheForceBeWithYou|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/AlMGe}}</ref>

While recording his lines, Stanton worked with Wood, who showed him the footage he was recording over and explained his scenes' context. Direction came remotely from London, while Stanton, Wood, and the sound team were in Burbank, California. Recording after filming was completed, Stanton had to match his performance to the emotion and physical swaying of the ''Profundity'' in Raddus's scenes. He never saw the full script, and for Raddus's line of "Rogue One, may the Force be with you," he did it wild without matching to a shot, so seeing the end product in the theater was emotional for him once he understood the line's weight. Stanton felt it was extra special to voice a major film character, particularly a new one who, as Story Group member [[Matt Martin]] described to him, "saved the Rebellion." He also appreciated all of ''Rogue One''{{'s}} connections to the first film,<ref name="Tarkin to Raddus" /> [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode ''IV A New Hope'']].<ref name="Moviemaking" />

Through an extended trailer for ''Andor'' Season 2 shown exclusively at [[Celebration Japan (2025)|''Star Wars'' Celebration Japan]] on [[April 18]], [[2025]], it was revealed that Raddus would be making an appearance within the second season of ''Star Wars: Andor''.<ref name="RaddusReturn">{{Twitter|username=sw_holocron|url=status/1913417354828300436|name=''Star Wars'' Holocron|date=2025-04-18|quote=An extended trailer for ANDOR Season 2 shown at Star Wars Celebration reveals Admiral Raddus is in the show.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/AeEDj}}</ref> The next day on [[April 19]], Stanton himself would publicly confirm Raddus's return through a social media post on Twitter.<ref name="RaddusReturn2">{{Twitter|username=Stephen_Stanton|url=status/1913472973287334259|name=[[Stephen Stanton]]|date=2025-04-19|quote="Raddus lives!" #Andor Season 2 begins April 22 on Disney+ ! #RogueOne #starwars #SWCJ #StarWarsCelebration #SWCJ準備中 #SWCJ2025|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/gAkGR}}</ref> After the season's release, Stanton thanked<ref name="StantonTweet" /> ''Andor''{{'s}} showrunner<ref name="WGA">{{WebCite|url=https://directories.wga.org/project/1225499/andor|text=Andor|date=2024-06-12|work=[[Wikipedia:Writers Guild of America|Writers Guild of America West]] Directory|archivedate=20240612175103}}</ref> [[Tony Gilroy]]<ref name="StantonTweet" /> and series writer<ref name="WGA" /> [[Dan Gilroy]] for featuring Raddus in the show's second season, expressing his joy to give voice to the character again. In reply to Stanton, Henri-Thomas—who had portrayed Raddus in ''Andor''—commented that he felt it was a privledge to portray Raddus physically, thus embodying the former's voice.<ref name="StantonTweet" />

There is a slight inconsistency across sources regarding Raddus's decision to bring the ''Profundity'' to reinforce Rogue One.<ref name="X-wing 90" /><ref name="RO5" /> In the film itself, when [[Private]] Tenzigo Weems tells Mothma that Raddus plans to join them, he says, "He's returned to his ship. He's going to fight."<ref name="Rogue One" /> A number of sources, including the [[June]] [[2020]]<ref name="X-wing date">{{WebCite|url=https://www.model-space.com/us/build-star-wars-x-wing-model.html|text=Star Wars Build your own X-wing | 1:18 Model on De Agostini Model Space|archivedate=20180819033322}} indicates that issues of ''[[Star Wars: Build Your Own X-Wing]]'' was shipped in sets of four every month starting in [[August]] [[2018]]. Thus issue 90 was released in [[June]] [[2020]].</ref> [[Star Wars: Build Your Own X-Wing 90|ninetieth issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Build Your Own X-Wing]]'' magazine,<ref name="X-wing 90" /> the [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'',<ref name="Geek" /> and the [[2019]] reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'', describe the ''Profundity'' as already having been "en route" to Tatooine to bring Organa aboard the ''Tantive IV''.<ref name="USWNE/SWE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' uses the phrase "en route." This detail was removed in the [[2024]] updated edition, ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''.</ref>

The [[August 2]], 2017<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/64287/star_wars_rogue_one_adaptation_2017_5|text=Star Wars: Rogue One Adaptation (2017) #5}}</ref> [[Rogue One Adaptation 5|fifth issue]] of [[Marvel Comics]]' [[Star Wars: Rogue One Adaptation|adaptation]] of the film, written by [[Jody Houser]], explicitly depicts Raddus as having been on Yavin when he decided to go to Scarif,<ref name="RO5" /> and ''Rogue One''{{'s}} junior novel notes that Raddus was in orbit [[Yavin system|above]] Yavin when he departed for Scarif.<ref name="JN" /> Furthermore, the [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]] are still on Yavin when Mothma is informed of Raddus's decision,<ref name="Rogue One" /> yet they are present in the ''Tantive IV'' in ''A New Hope'', directly after the plans were stolen.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Therefore, this article aligns with the latter interpretation of Weems's line and assumes that Raddus left for Scarif from Yavin.

''Rogue One''{{'s}} novelization depicts the ''Profundity'' receiving the plans after the Death Star has arrived in the Scarif [[Star system|system]],<ref name="Novel" /> but in the film, its transmission is complete before the superweapon emerges from hyperspace.<ref name="Rogue One" /> The 2018 reference book ''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]'', written by [[Natalie Clubb]] and [[Katrina Pallant]], mistakenly refers to Raddus as a general.<ref name="AA" /> The English edition of "[[The Birth of the Rebellion]]," a [[2023]] [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] reference book<ref name="Birth 2" /> written by [[Tim Veekhoven]],<ref name="SM">{{DMCite|dm=File:TimVeekhoven-Credits.png|creator=Tim Veekhoven}}</ref> mistakenly refers to the ''Profundity'' as "Raddus" on one occasion.<ref name="Birth" />
